title: A colimit of sheaves of sets is the sheafification of the presheaf colimit
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ be its opens site, whose objects are open subsets and whose covering families are open covers [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $I$ be a small category and let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be a diagram of sheaves of sets on $\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define the presheaf $\mathcal P$ by $\mathcal P(U)=\varinjlim_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i(U)$, with restriction maps induced by the diagram and with the colimit coprojections [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $\eta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ be the sheafification of this presheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then $\mathcal P^\#$, with the composite maps $\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal P\xrightarrow{\eta}\mathcal P^\#$, is a colimit of the diagram $(\mathcal F_i)$ in the category of sheaves of sets on $\operatorname{Opens}(X)$: for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal H$, composition with the composites induces a bijection between morphisms $\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal H$ and compatible cocones of maps $\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal H$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Sheaves, Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), item (3): colimits of sheaves are sheafifications of the objectwise presheaf colimits

mathlib_searches.query: on the opens site of a topological space, colimit of sheaves of sets is obtained by sheafifying the objectwise presheaf colimit
opens site topological space: sheafify objectwise colimit gives colimit in category of sheaves

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Limits.lean:189 defines Sheaf.sheafifyCocone; :213-216 defines Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone and proves it by the universal property of presheafToSheaf

mathlib_match.how: For `D = Type` and the opens-site topology, line 213 takes an objectwise presheaf colimit cocone `E` and returns the sheafified cocone; line 214 states that it is a colimit, and lines 215-216 prove the universal property by transporting the presheaf colimit through the left adjoint `presheafToSheaf` and the precomposition hom equivalence. This is exactly the stated compatible-cocone bijection.
